comprehensibility.reason: Needs outside knowledge of where 'maximum charging power' and 'nominal pack voltage' are defined.
comprehensibility.suggestion: Point to REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER and the product's HV voltage class.

feasibility.reason: Capping current at P/V_nominal yields less than P whenever the pack voltage is below nominal (low SoC), which pushes against REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER's 'at least' average power over 20-80 % SoC, and it ignores the BMS cell limits.
feasibility.suggestion: Cap by the BMS-permitted charging current and the interface rating rather than a nominal-voltage quotient.

parent_fit.reason: The parent ARCH_CHG_SESSION_CONTROL sets the current limit 'from the BMS cell limits'; this requirement derives it from maximum charging power / nominal pack voltage instead, so it does not engage with the parent's chosen basis.
parent_fit.suggestion: Derive the requested current from the BMS-published limits (and cap it by the interface rating), or change the parent design if power/voltage is the intended rule.

unambiguity.reason: 'maximum charging power' is not tied to a source (REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER value, a minimum average, vs. a charger maximum).
unambiguity.suggestion: Reference the field explicitly, e.g. 'the value of REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER'.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/chg (bev-only folder); every alternative of the parent is also inside bev and the market/inlet alternatives are exhaustive (Kconfig: region eu|na; mcs needs v800 needs bev), so the need never exists without a parent.

verifiability.reason: The cap is computable from two product values and checkable on the charger interface.
